subject: RE: FW: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - KUL / 105 CTN 35 KGS
body:
Dear Air Freight Team,

Our buyer in Lima is importing machine parts from us in Germany, and we are arranging the flight for their import. Could you please quote the fastest option to LIM (Lima, PE), including truck pickup from our site in 61882 (Bad Homburg), Germany, and transport to the departure airport?

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27. It consists of 5 pieces with a gross weight of 179 kg and a total volume of 0.76 cbm.

Please quote an all-in price in EUR and attach your offer as a PDF to your reply so that our purchasing department can file it.

Thank you.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-09-23
Subject: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - KUL / 105 CTN 35 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex BRUSSELS AIRPORT to KUL:
105 CTN / 35 KGS / 12.8 CBM, precision instruments
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer requests a new all-in quote for a shipment to Lima, including pickup and airport transport.
